REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
WEDNESDAY - DECEMBER 3, 2025 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Community Development Department, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Community Development Department during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to planning@cerritos.gov or by phone at (562) 916-1201 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 5.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to planning@cerritos.gov or by hard copy to the Community Development Department no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Community Development Department at (562) 916-1201 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

CITY OF CERRITOS

  MINUTES

Regular Planning Commission Meeting
December 3, 2025
City Council Chambers
18125 Bloomfield Ave
Cerritos, California 90703

PRESENT:  Commissioner Benjamin Ao
  Commissioner Kiritkumar Chauhan
  Chair Jose “Armin” Reyes

PRESENT:  Assistant City Attorney Shukan Patel
  Deputy City Manager/Acting Director of Community Development Ryan Carey
  Director of Public Works/ City Engineer Alvin Papa
  Assistant Director of Public Works Chris Kuebert
  Assistant City Engineer Jared Lee
  Current Planning Manager Amanda Acuña

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Chair Reyes.

3.  Roll Call

  All Members of the Planning Commission were declared present, except
  Commissioner Surti and Vice Chair Jhaveri who were noted absent and excused by a
  majority consensus of the Planning Commission.

4.  Presentations

  Review and consideration of an informational presentation by the Public Works
  Department of the proposed water and sewer rate adjustments.

  A staff report was given by Director of Public Works/ City Engineer Alvin Papa and
  Assistant Director of Public Works Chris Kuebert. A PowerPoint presentation was
  displayed, providing details about the City of Cerritos current water and sewer
  infrastructure, what services residents are currently paying for and the proposed
  water and sewer rate adjustments. The presentation provided an overview of the
  current conditions of the City’s four (4) ground water wells and proposed water and
  sewer rate adjustments to help maintain reliable and safe water service to Cerritos
  residents.

  Discussion followed regarding Proposition 218 and what it means for the City of
  Cerritos, how the City separates operations and capital expenses, ground water
  pumping, and where additional information be found.

City of Cerritos  December 3, 2025
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 1
   Chair Reyes opened the public hearing. Cerritos resident Deborah Berry provided
  comments in support of the proposed water and sewer rate adjustments.

  Cerritos resident Robert provided comments in opposition to the proposed water and
  sewer rate adjustments and his concerns of the cost to Cerritos residents. Seeing
  and hearing no other speakers wishing to address the Planning Commission, Chair
  Reyes closed public comments.

5.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Chair Reyes invited comments and suggestions from the public on items not listed on
  the agenda. Seeing and hearing no speakers wishing to address the Planning
  Commission, Chair Reyes closed public comments.

6.  Consent Calendar

6A.  Approval of Minutes

  Wednesday, November 5, 2025, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes.

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Chauhan, and seconded by Commissioner
  Ao, to approve the Wednesday, November 5, 2025, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission
  Regular Meeting Minutes.

  The motion carried (3-0-2-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Surti, Jhaveri
  ABSTAIN:  None

7.  Public Hearings

7A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 2025-11, A
  PROPOSAL BY THE RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY OWNERS TO CONSTRUCT A FIRST-
  FLOOR ADDITION AND NEW SECOND FLOOR TO AN EXISTING SINGLE-STORY
  RESIDENCE AT 13345 ASHWORTH STREET, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE
  SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL (RS-5000) (APN 7027-
  013-003).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  Chair Reyes recused himself due to a conflict of interest.

  No action was taken due to a lack of quorum. Assistant City Attorney Patel stated
  this item will be continued to the January 14, 2026 Special Meeting of the Planning
  Commission.

8.  Reports

8A.  Reports from Designated Commission Liaison
City of Cerritos  December 3, 2025
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 2
   There were no reports from the Designated Commission Liaison to the Planning
  Commission.

8B.  Reports from Planning Commission Members

  Reports were given by Commissioner Chauhan, and Chair Reyes.

9.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 8:22 p.m.

  /s/Amanda Acuña
  Amanda Acuña
  Secretary to the Planning Commission

/s/Jose “Armin” Reyes
